claim: The best of 560 trios, best legal weapon, Offensive stance, abilities on cooldown, reaches 634.0 DPS at average mitigation.

inputs.name: damage chain
inputs.source: DAMAGE-CHAIN.md, validated to +1.6% on the slash lane of a fully-pinned character

inputs.name: HandMod 1H
inputs.source: eqlwiki Game_Mechanics observation table, re-fetched raw 43,724 B on 29 Aug; corroborated by an Efreeti Standard statblock (T2)

inputs.name: item corpus
inputs.source: 18 slot files scraped from eqlwiki item pages

assumptions.text: best legal weapon in an 18-file corpus for every trio
Offensive stance permanently on for every martial trio
every ability fired the instant it leaves cooldown
three classes' spell lanes sustained at once by one pair of hands
a Shaman proc buff granted to every trio whether or not one is in it -- worth 8.4% of the median trio and 17.8% of the worst, so it compresses the ranking as well as raising it

residual.unit: ratio of model floor to measured median
residual.note: 162 of 213 measured fights fall BELOW this model's own worst trio

stops: not claimed as an achievable output for any player
falsifier: Any logged fight whose per-character DPS exceeds 634.0, or any set of fights with gear recorded whose median lands within 20% of the model floor.
internal_only_reason: A DENOMINATOR, not a finding. It is computable from an item catalogue and a damage chain with no log at all, so as a shipping claim it fails the catalogue test and belongs to eqlegendstools.com. Its only use here is as the reference against which a player's OBSERVED output is differenced. The gap is ours; the ceiling is not, and it is never shown to a reader in any form.
